{{Quote|You sure you didn’t just dream up these guys, Solo?|Flind, to Han Solo|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Flind''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] part of the contingent invited to the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. Alongside [[Erick]], he was ordered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] to accompany the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] back to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', in order to question the three unidentified sentries whom Solo had encountered earlier. By the time they arrived, however, the sentries had disappeared. Finding the situation suspicious, Solo ordered Flind and Erick to scan the ''Falcon's'' exterior with [[EnhanceScan general purpose scanner/Legends|EnhanceScan portable scanners]] for any tracking devices.<ref name="COO" />
